title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — November 08, 2026

The Sun has been active today, so Sunny is checking in on the outer corona.

🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.9

We're watching the corona today!

Today’s solar images show a compact sunspot group, several bright active regions, and a broad dark coronal region.

Image: NOAA SWPC — LASCO C3
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
